title: Warm Spicy Algerian Lamb Tagine
description: A savory and juicy Algerian dish featuring minced garlic and pickle, suitable for kids and flexitarian diets. This tagine is a perfect blend of spices and flavors.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the lamb pieces and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the chopped pickle, ground cumin, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken broth and dried apricots, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 1 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro.
Traditionally, tagine is served with crusty bread or over couscous.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
Note: this recipe is for refrigerator pickling/preserving only — store in the refrigerator and consume within 1 week. Do not water-bath can without an acid (vinegar or lemon juice).
